name: Pixi On-the-Glow Blush CheekTone Multi-Use pH Reactive Balm for Cheeks and Lips
description:
Add a natural glow to your beauty routine with Pixi On-the-Glow Blush CheekTone. This solid, pH-reactive balm adjusts to your unique skin tone, creating a custom shade with a sheer, radiant finish. Infused with ginseng, aloe vera, and fruit extracts, it nourishes and hydrates while delivering buildable color. With its smooth, blendable texture and travel-friendly design, it’s the perfect all-in-one tint for cheeks and lips. Suitable for all skin types, paraben-free, and cruelty-free.
Key Features:
 Volume: 19g / 0.6oz
 Multi-use balm for cheeks and lips
 pH-reactive tint creates a custom shade
 Infused with ginseng, aloe vera, and fruit extracts
 Hydrating formula conditions as it colors
 Suitable for all skin types, paraben-free, cruelty-free
How to Use:
 Twist base to wind up or down
 Swipe gently onto cheeks or lips
 Blend with fingertips for a natural glow
 Close lid tightly after use
Ingredients:
Fruit Extracts, Ginseng, Aloe Vera, Hydrating botanical agents
Safety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Discontinue use if irritation occurs
 Store in a cool, dry place
Package Includes:
 1 × Pixi On-the-Glow Blush CheekTone 19g
